text:
name="dev"
echo "Hello, $name"

for file in *.log; do
  echo "Compressing $file"
  gzip "$file"
done

cd ~/projects
ls -la
pwd

mkdir -p build/logs
cp config.txt build/
mv old.txt archive/old.txt

NAME="dev"
COUNT=3
echo "Hello, $NAME x$COUNT"

cat app.log | grep "ERROR" | wc -l
ls | head -n 5

if [ -d "$DIR" ]; then
  echo "exists"
else
  mkdir "$DIR"
fi

while read -r line; do
  echo "Line: $line"
done < input.txt

find . -name "*.tmp" -type f -mtime +7 -delete
find src -name "*.js" | xargs wc -l

if [ $# -lt 1 ]; then
  echo "Usage: $0 <file>" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "Processing $1"

awk -F, '{ sum += $3 } END { print sum }' sales.csv
sed -i 's/foo/bar/g' config.txt

files=(a.txt b.txt c.txt)
for f in "${files[@]}"; do
  [ -f "$f" ] && echo "found $f"
done

touch notes.txt
rm notes.txt
rm -r old_folder
ls -lh

echo "first" > log.txt
echo "second" >> log.txt
cat log.txt

sort names.txt | uniq
head -n 3 names.txt
tail -f app.log

chmod +x script.sh
./script.sh
which python3
history | tail

export PATH="$HOME/bin:$PATH"
export EDITOR=vim
echo $PATH | tr ':' '\n'

for i in $(seq 1 5); do
  echo "Item $i"
done
for i in {1..3}; do echo "n$i"; done

curl -s https://api.example.com/users | jq '.[] | .name'
curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"a":1}' "$URL"

tar -czf backup.tar.gz ./project
tar -xzf backup.tar.gz -C /tmp
zip -r site.zip public/

ssh user@server.example.com
scp ./app.tar.gz user@server:/var/www/
rsync -avz ./dist/ user@server:/var/www/

tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT

cp data.csv "$tmp/"
echo "working in $tmp"

file="report.final.txt"
echo "${file%.txt}"
echo "${file##*.}"
echo "${name:-default}"
echo "${#file}"

diff <(sort a.txt) <(sort b.txt)
while IFS=, read -r id name; do
  echo "$id -> $name"
done < users.csv
